adversarial_notes: The reviewed commit is not an ancestor of the earlier re-earn branch head c634df6 - it was rebuilt on 1217b85. That is acceptable because the artifact names tested_commit 89b3bc7 explicitly and the worktree repo_89b3 is at exactly 89b3bc7 with no dirty tracked files; branch ancestry is not a stated requirement of this card.

The ADD-10 persisting submit leaves the modal open and surfaces status_text "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'reset')". The reset error is cosmetic (the wallet WAS persisted, wallet count 5->6, sha changed) and does not invalidate the row, but it is a real UI defect and is recorded here rather than suppressed.

NON_NUMERIC_NORM_BASE_SILENTLY_COERCED is confirmed against the committed raw artifact: norm_base 'abc' returns 200 and persists 100. Not disqualifying for ADD-10 because the row requirement is met by the BAD_WALLET path, but it is a validation gap worth a follow-up card.

Rows 01-05 were exercised by direct HTTP POST to /api/live-config/add-wallet, not through the browser form; ADD-10 alone covers the real form path. The card asked for persisted round-trip per row and one real-form submit, so this split is within scope.
